intent: Close the first real V0 economy loop by consuming canonical ore produced by live P3 mining through the existing single-owner M4 Item Graph and Construction transaction boundaries, then prove publication, two-client convergence and reconnect without adding duplicate truth or changing the SERVER_PREDICTED network foundation.
root_cause_or_reason: Before P4, Construction could advance without proving and exactly consuming the canonical ore produced by P3. Exact stack exhaustion was rejected, live M4 material allocation/transaction wiring was absent, and post-commit publication did not replicate the Item Graph debit alongside Construction progress.
changed_surfaces: live M4 single-owner Construction transaction port
post-commit Item Graph delta + Construction event publication/fallback
world/core regression coverage repair integrated from independently reviewed PR #122
canonical_owner: Canonical M4 Item Graph remains the sole item/resource truth; existing Construction authority/M0 remains the sole Construction truth.
entry_points: P4 live M4 Construction build process
P3 authoritative resource mining request path
callers: M3 real ENet clients through existing COMMAND_REQUEST path
P4 focused and process acceptance drivers
production_diff_summary: P4 extends the existing single-owner canonical M4/Construction path only. Exact exhaustion is represented as DELETE + CONSUME_MATERIAL; requesting-player ore is allocated deterministically; the same live M4 instance is debited with the existing Construction authority/M0 commit; successful commits publish Item Graph and Construction changes with full-snapshot fallback. No new Item Graph, Construction, persistence, resource-balance or network authority owner was introduced.
remaining_risks: P4 proves a bounded canonical ore economy loop, not a general multi-resource crafting framework.
Full-snapshot publication fallback is correctness-first and may be expensive under later scale targets.
The validated M4 + Construction/M0 atomic sequence is intentionally narrow and is not a general distributed transaction framework.
Final checkpoint acceptance still requires fresh independent P4 Reviewer and Verifier gates on the exact closure head.
rank_up_moves: After formal P4 acceptance, continue the product sequence to P5 rather than expanding P4 scope.
Future CI may shard the now-complete 236-test world/core gate while preserving fail-closed test discovery.
evidence_gaps: Fresh independent final P4 Reviewer verdict on the exact closure head.
